scope: Scheduled Excel export of a native dashboard page, run by the task scheduler as the marketing role's scheduled-task account

environment.stack: development Compose stack (StarRocks 4.1.4 patched FE, Ranger, PG17) with host dev processes
environment.runner: nova_task_service_marketing, bound to marketing with scripts.provision_task_schedule_role

fixture: Shared workspace shared with marketing (edit); dashboard with one bar chart over a SQL dataset on analytics.sales; dashboard, chart and dataset published and granted to marketing (dashboard: view, export)

attempts.step: save as ACCOUNTADMIN in the dialog
attempts.evidence: 'Switch to a business role to schedule exports. Administration roles do not run scheduled work.'

attempts.cause: document permission check revalidated a sign-in session the scheduled account never has
attempts.fix: read-only scheduled_permissions probe; task sessions accepted only inside the matching worker delegation

attempts.cause: task metadata login could not read Dataviz documents or workspaces
attempts.fix: migration 0054 (reads, workspace entry insert, audit) with PG17 grant/RLS tests

attempts.cause: chart and dataset were not granted to the role (the Share dialog grants them; the API setup had not)
dataset schema check decrypted a sign-in password; native dataset and bound queries refused any supplied connection
attempts.fix: catalog reads and dataset queries use the worker's delegated session when it is exactly this account's; client connections still refused

attempts.evidence: workbook bdfa8908-87c5-4a2b-9a1f-0ae3b0bfc15f saved under Scheduled exports

attempts.cause: internal handler heartbeat called a repository method that no longer exists (affected every scheduled internal handler); recorded error was only 'unhandled errors in a TaskGroup'
attempts.fix: worker lease renewal passed to internal handlers; the handler's own error is recorded

attempts.evidence: graph run success; workbook 8389444d-e34b-4223-a865-a67792d44c21 'Presence check Overview 2026-11-16 0557.xlsx' (1,597 bytes)

workbook_check.download: GET workspace file download as the workspace owner: 200, spreadsheet media type, attachment file name
workbook_check.content: one sheet 'Amount by city', headers 'City' and 'Sum of amount', no data rows
workbook_check.governance: Ranger row filters on analytics.sales are per person (alice Jakarta, bob Bandung); the role's own account reads no rows, so the file holds none. The same query run directly as the account returns no rows.

audit: SCHEDULE_EXPORT rows for alice with the dashboard and page
